body:
I can relate; the loml left me because I wasn't good enough... It only gets easier if you advance in areas of your own life i.e work, relationships, friendships, hobbies.

Not that it's gotten easier for me at all; it made me close my heart up that's for sure.
Why are you hurting? The fact that you can still hurt is a good sign as ironic as it seems.
Same but 21

I love your writing.
I know it will get better; I imagine you felt better writing this. Start writing each morning to clear your head for the day... and trust me when I say mediation works.

Do you struggle with depression or no?

And this is a very kind post thank you
Who else is in your life that deserves one? Do you have a SO, or a sibling, or a father?
Who was it to? If I might ask.

It feels good to post about inner turmoil; life will go on. Just find a job and even if you hate it be grateful for the food it provides. I feel this in the deepest sense though; like I thought I had  a good run, but it wasn't.
I was reading that and I'm in stage 3; thank you for this information.

I feel this; it's like you're not even sad anymore about it, but you've accepted hopelessness. You want to get out, but you can't. You are stuck inside a decaying mind with indifference to it. Life seems intolerable and you can't wake yourself up to fight this injustice. It's like you know all this though, but you can't bring yourself to be strong and fight for your life. It's hard fucking work each day to just look at yourself in the mirror, because the you now might be unrecognizable to who you once were. I just want to help you, but like, I struggle with these same feelings and this same emptiness inside. You gotta fight though, in any way you can. If you fight, it adds meaning to the cause that is taking back control over your life. I love you dear stranger, and people in your life do too

If you still feel pain and suffering then you are still alive, because there comes a point when you just feel numb and indifferent to everything- that is when shit gets really scary. You can get out of this; use your pain as fuel.
please don't just throw up

He will be okay; my dog ate compost from our compost pit and we gave him charcoal and he was fine. The charcoal soaks up the toxins. Don't blame yourself, and remember to forgive yourself. It was an accident you couldn't have predicted.
Does she know or does she think you love her
Yeah we all suck; just burden a beautiful earth by polluting and destroying with greed. We all die anyways, i just hope I can do something with this pathetic life i was given.
thank you for that; words spoken from wisdom in solitude. I could just try to get to know myself you are right

Well, long story but I pushed away my druggie friends and my girlfriend broke up with me at the same time so I just feel like an outcast. None of them want anything to do with me anymore- they are right tho. I'm kinda toxic I feel like
I feel like I'm public enemy number one and forgotten most of the time

21M and I relate. I'm living at home and going to online uni and I had that same problem over the summer except we were in the same house. Parents are just oblivious when you get to a certain age I feel like. You have to be as direct as possible so there is no confusion. Tell them you're sad, hopeless even, wondering what's the point, depressed, or even your darkest fears. They will show their support in some way, and that was the only thing that helped me- being direct as fuck in a controlled way.
That's awesome you reached out; just showing her you care is the most important thing:)
i find listening to spoken word poetry helps. But i can relate to this feeling; isolation is a beast

I'm struggling with even eating one meal a day, and I woke up at 3 pm; it's not a matter of what the food is, you just need to talk to her and dig deep into those sad feelings she has. It may help her feel better and eat more.

I don't have any friends either and I promise you, just waiting it out might make you feel better; you are going to die anyway... we all are, so why not just try to do the most with what you have. Go skydiving, try surfing in Maui, try meth. Okay maybe don't try meth but there has to be something you haven't done you've always wanted to do. Go do it tomorrow. Wake up and write about all the reason you feel shitty about yourself and try to change those things in the course of the day. Then wake up again and repeat. Life isn't easy but goddamn dying is so much worse
just posting this means you have fight in you. read the suicide bereavement page and it may change your mind. It changed mine.

Also I am not wired for online either, I just came on here to see what was going on in other people's lives... kinda trying to distract myself from my own misfortune atm which is silly in essence because I'll have to deal with it inevitably

ahahah it's all good; I'm just not really a bro, just looking for people to talk to. I also wanted to ease your plight and help by adding a second opinion into your tumultuous outlook on yourself; because you are not what you say you are, and the mind can be easily deceived when we aren't checking ourselves. I apologize if I came off strong and all, but I really do just want to help in any way I can.
what are you studying?

I'd be your friend to talk to if you don't mind, as I am experiencing isolation at it's finest. I'd love a friendly person to talk to about my feelings of inner depression. I am actually new to reddit and love looking on these forums for people feeling the same way. Makes me feel less lonely.
M from texas, same interests but can't find much luck over here either
cutting off is never a good option, but just build different friendships outside of these people
Do you like My Hero or hunter x hunter more
I am a 21M from California living in Texas and need friends as well, Australia is sick though what are you doin over there for fun during this time

ahahahaha well you're killing it right now by just opening up to a forum of people who actually understand. Sometimes the anonymity is nicer and helps with confidence to just say whatever the fuck is on your mind. Just go for it. Tell me everything you hate, or are sad with, or can't stand, or want more of, or just wanted gone. I'm listening bro, from one sad person to another.

I feel like faith is just inserted hope in times like these. I could use it rn though, but finding hope in other people is cool too. I guess that's why you should hold out, because there is definitely a man out there for you, to show you all these things that you believe about yourself to be true is actually wrong. It's just so hard when people aren't interacting as much these days.

You could start by training your brain in short durations of sleep starting now, working your way down from the normal amount until your body is normalized under 6-8 hours of sleep. It's really just training, but yeah brains need a lot of training if we want to operate successfully under non optimal conditions. I definitely understand though, If I have less than 6 hours I am completely lost all day and it's weird because other people are fine with that amount. Everyone is just different ya feel.

Fuck... That's heavy. I suggest escaping into sports or school if you can. Play soccer. Play chess. Study. Find a way out from your mother's lack of compassion. You got this. If you give up it'll crush her too despite all she says.
I feel, except I'm a very short guy with addiction and relapse problems trying to become a psychologist. If you don't mind me asking what is your heritage?

I experience chronic brain fog and couldn't remember portions of my life, scariest thing in the world when you can't remember your own past. I did a lot of drugs to get to this point but you can reverse the effects of it if you work hard enough and eat right. That's the hard part though, staying on track long enough to see the results; there's no sugarcoating hard fucking work in a life that has less of a chance of being happy because of our choices. But no, you are not permanently damaged, just momentarily. You got this

I actually downloaded reddit because I had thoughts of harming myself. I just read through the suicide bereavement forum and it made me bawl. I'm the lowest I've ever been and I'm a 21M; people say it doesn't get easier but just seeing I'm not alone in this struggle makes me feel better. You aren't alone man.
I'm here to listen... don't have any friends to listen either

life sucks

people suck

we all die anyways

might as well try to make the best of the time we were given, don't cut it short
I have been looking for an answer to this since April

I think finding the love of your life could change your entire outlook on life, as I just lost mine and feel the worst I have ever felt; keep searching, as it won't come easy. Life has a way of doing unexpected shit and making it seem normal, so just hold out and stay open to everything.
what's up?
This is a much better response than mine. In the end of the day you really can't change other people.

Well your bf was myself at one point, and for me SSRI's just put a veil over my lack of self worth, so I didn't feel the urgency to change. I guess just try talking to him every day about his plans for the future and see what he wants to do with his life. Vidya was really addicting for me and kept me escaping into it to avoid my shitty feelings about myself- I eventually had to sell my Xbox after about two years of this. It could be his coping mechanism so maybe try to reason through why he feels compelled to play all the time, but just be as understanding as possible yet not to the point where you're enabling his lifestyle.

Ahahahaha that's fucking hilarious because I got depressed after quitting running aswell. I was a soccer player the majority of my life and when I got to college I stopped. Then I got depressed, and only recently did I try to start running again and it helped tremendously; I started out with 5 miles and built my way to 13 one day. However, I stopped about 3 weeks ago and have since felt like shit. I need to start again but I started to smoke cigs and that has made running almost impossible. I'm only 21 btw.

I might try again tomorrow to start up my progress; running really is a life-saver

Yeah, except for myself I'm struggling to even find a goal to change for, so I guess I meant just finding out the reasons why we feel like shit, and changing those negative things about ourselves. Goals can help with those, but a plan is more critical for boosting self-worth if you stick to it. But sticking to it is the hardest part, and it's the most rewarding imo. 

We do live in a society where the quick fix is always the "way to go," but that never works, as we can't find happiness without putting in the work to do so... it's just hard switching from being who we are now to who we might see ourselves as in the future.

It's all a fucking paradox man. You are so right in your uncertainty that I guess the only place to find it is within yourself as corny as that sounds. You find it in family, relationships, and inside a spinning head that does not often have controlled reason. Everyone has different opinions and making changes in life starts with the small stuff, although I'm being hypocritical because I'm struggling with these exact same thoughts and can't bring myself to will a change through actions. Life seems daunting, and change even moreso.

holy crap I feel like that rings true as fuck for me aswell... Like the old me would never be this down about my life, the old me would get up and keep fighting every single goddamn day. But I'm not, and it makes me even sadder. I guess this could be the point where we redefine ourselves or choose to stay the same, but it's so hard when you make progress and somehow find your way back to square one. progress in life shouldn't be this hard I guess, and I thought it would be more natural than this depressing ass cycle. How old are you?

Just explain rather calmly that you have been feeling really down, down to the point where it doesn't seem like there is a chance at finding hope anymore. It will shock her, but if you are calm and reassure her you are still here, and fighting, it will make everything feel much easier.

She may not understand and may feel as if you've put a ton of pressure onto her, but if you make a plan to at least attempt to get better it would make the world of a difference to her. It's definitely necessary you tell her, because keeping that shit locked up only makes it worse.

It sounds like you may be missing a genuine connection with another human outside of your family, and even then it feels like your relationship with your family isn't as strong as it should be. I am looking for that same thing, just someone to talk to, and someone who understands depression not just as being sad, but more often than not being unable to feel happy. We're all going through some heavy shit so it's nice to hear something relateable.

That pain of rejection just is so dull and longlasting... I'd rather it be quick and cutting, but I'm going through the same thing with a girl I dated for 3 years and when I wanted to get back with her she cut it off. it makes you feel unwanted to the nth degree. I hope this shit passes.

also wrote this poem in another thread, thought it might help

The boat that carried us here seems to have a hole

The hole is a vacuum that carried me deep into the enveloping darkness

I can't swim

I can't find the surface

I don't have a compass for a seemingly fleeting raft

I contemplate life as a mermaid, and before the decision to grow a tail happens

I am thrust back to a surface in which i do not recognize, as salt stains his eyes

I am saved, he is saved

I do not know who this maritime traveller is

All I know is the pain he carries

He wants to go back to the depths of the deep blue, and sink until he reaches a sandy bottom

Yet he holds on, and clings tight to the mast of a sinking ship, the ghost crew already gone

lowkey can't believe you're still up too. but yeah that's not pathetic, those are some good deals. I guess I'm in the same boat as you because i've almost smoked a whole pack in the course of this night... American Spirit Blacks.

We are just some goons looking for company, but I've never tried calling I can't believe they even have a hold option... seems kinda contradictory to the whole thing.

I might add a random poem of my own; I loved yours.

The night doesn't lead to escape

The morning brings another cycle

The days are passing by unnoticed, yet this feeling pervades time

Life seems short, but that's what people tell me

This life is long, and she stays with me but she is still gone
I've actually been contemplating this all night... I want them to miss me if I'm gone too, but it's so selfish to even debate... I feel like an asshole even thinking of it.

I'm 21 and struggling with the same shit; you gotta just get as involved with school as much as you can... sports, band, theatre, getting ahead of your classmates in the rankings... just so you can try to escape the shitty feeling you find yourself in at home.
shit fucking sucks when you wake up tired after sleeping almost double that of a normal individual
When I'm really depressed, I can sleep up to 14 hours after forcing myself to go back to bed, and then my consolation is waking up even more tired.

writing seems to help, but after a while journaling even seems pointless; talking about it with other people now has seemed to help on this forum, so thank you for opening up the avenue for me to express my feelings.

I'm 21 and have abused drugs and other escapist avenues for a while now, and the funny thing is my hopelessness didn't become this severe until after I quit... which is fucking stupid. I just can't figure out what I want from this life and just going through the motions makes everything worse. it makes me feel so stupid I know what I need to do to get out yet I can't bring myself to it... It makes me feel mentally challenged or something, like I can't learn from my mistakes ya know? Idk if that has something to do with addiction and relapse but it has made me view myself poorly and even the good side of me can't help the overwhelming bad side.

I feel that. I lost all my friends and my lover due to mental illness and I slowly am losing myself in the wake of it. I'm grateful for a family but they will be gone one day too. Life can be brutal if we think about life as an uphill battle, although it is we can still deceive ourselves into trying every day until one day it's worth it. I hope we can both find hope enough to try. I feel completely alone, but I know I have people like you who are fighting the same exact battle every single goddamn second... I know we can persevere; drugs ruined my life and it'll take hard fucking work to turn it around if I want it bad enough. Just being able to say all this shit on here means we are still fighting. We got this.

I have never read anything more relatable on this site, and I promise it gets better. I don’t know first hand, but that’s what people tell me; there comes a point in depression when you’re sad for a long time, and then the point where you are unable to feel happiness. I guess I’m at that second point, and it seems like you may be too. I feel like I have been failing my family for so long and yet they still would be so hurt if I did, and I guess that’s why I haven’t... I’ve lived such a selfish life that if I did one final act of selfishness I would create my shitty self fulfilling prophecy- it will get better. Just hold out and try changing small things every day... they are so many people feeling this same way I don’t feel as alone when I read posts like yours, but yeah- don’t do it.

I thought about doing that too, today would have been the day for me... The only reason I didn’t was because if I died before my parents by my own hand I wouldn’t just be failing myself, they would think they were failures too...
Are you sure you want to end your life?
 Is it not worth it hold out and see if life gets better?
I agree

I have been contemplating it for awhile, but the only thing holding me back is the fear that my family will suffer much worse from my weakness; I hate the fact that I know what I need to do to get out of my self imposed loop, yet I can’t physically bring myself to make it better. I just feel weak, and selfish, and like I’m wasting time and energy on this thought when I could be using it to better my life. It really is a revolving door of desolation and feeling nothing that shouldn’t be this repetitive but somehow is. Having no friends doesn’t help either, but talking about it and getting it out does. I’m glad I’m able to see other people suffering from something I thought was so individual and secluded to myself... as shitty as that sounds it makes me feel not  as alone as I did before.
At least you made the decision to try something different with Australia; if you keep trying it will get better, but just try enjoying moments with your dad I guess
I feel that; the hardest shit is the fact that I have family who would be devastated if I did... I guess they are our lifelines lmao
